lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ is in the derivative form: مَوْءُودَةٌ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
و/أ/د   w–ʾ–d loud thudding sound, sound of heavy steps on the ground; to be swallowed by the earth; to bury alive, particularly a newborn girl; to be deliberate, solemnity. Of this root, only مَوْءُودَةٌ mawʾūdatun, occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مَوْءُودَةٌ mawʾūdatun [pass. part.] a female infant buried alive. The live burial of baby girls was a fairly common practice in pre‐Islamic Arabia, particularly amongst the Bedouin poor

(81:8–9) وَإِذَا الْمَوْءُودَةُ سُئِلَتْ بِأَيِّ ذَنْبٍ قُتِلَتْ [on the day] when the baby girl buried alive is asked for what crime she was killed.
